info.name: Fence OpenAPI Specification admin/user login API

params.name: shib_idp
params.description: Identifier for the shibboleth IDP. Available identifiers are what is listed by the `login.bionimbus.org/Shibboleth.sso/DiscoFeed` endpoint. If no `shib_idp` is specified, defaults to NIH login.

items.docs:
NOTE that this endpoint only exists if shibboleth is enabled as an
identity provider in the fence config. Currently this only happens for
`login.bionimbus.org`.

info.name: Initiate login via Fence provider (multi-tenant Fence)

params.name: idp
params.description: Identifier for the IDP. Specifying `idp=shibboleth` lets us specify a `shib_idp`. If no `idp` is specified, defaults to NIH login.
